1.text: Van leh lei, leh mihing a kipiansakna

info.name: Piancilna
info.desc: Piancilna cih kammal pen ‘kipatna’ a cihna ahi hi. Hih laibu sungah van leh lei

1.text: A kipat cil-in Pasian in vantung le leitung a piangsak hi.
1.title: Leitung le Mihing Piansakna

2.text: Leitung in limlemel nei loin a awngthawlpi ahi hi. Tuipi tung tengah khua mial bikbek a, tua tui tungah Pasian’ Kha in na a sem hi.

3.text: Pasian in, “Khuavak om hen,” ci hi; tua ciangin khuavak om pah hi.

4.text: Pasian in tua khuavak hoih hi, ci-in a mu hi. Pasian in khuamial panin khuavak khenkhia hi.

5.text: Pasian in khuavak pen “Sun” ci a, khuamial pen “Zan” ci hi. Nitak hong bei-in, zingsang hong tung a, ni khat ni ahi hi.

6.text: Pasian in, “Tuite’ laizangah van kuumpi om hen la, tua van kuumpi in tui le tui kikhensak hen,” ci hi.

7.text: Pasian in van kuumpi bawl a, van kuumpi tunga om tuite le van kuumpi nuai-a om tuite a khen hi. Tua mah bangin a piang pah hi.

8.text: Pasian in van kuumpi pen “Vantung” ci hi. Nitak hong bei-in zingsang hong tung a, ni nih ni ahi hi.

9.text: Pasian in, “Vantungte nuai-a om tuite mun khatah kikhawm hen la, lei keu kidawk hen,” ci hi. Tua mah bangin a piang pah hi.

10.text: Pasian in lei keu pen “Leitung” ci a, a kikaikhawm tuite pen “Tuipi” ci hi. Pasian in tua pen hoih hi, ci-in a mu hi.

11.text: Pasian in, “Leitung in kung tuamtuamte piangsak hen la, tang a nei kungnote, a gah sungah tang a om singgah kungte, amau’ nam ciatin leitungah piangsak hen,” ci hi. Tua mah bangin a piang pah hi.

12.text: Leitung in kung tuamtuamte piangkhiasak a, kungnote in amau’ nam ciatin tang piangsakin, singkung in a sungah tang a om gahte piangsakin, amau’ nam ciatciatin piangsak hi. Pasian in tua pen hoih hi, ci-in a mu hi.

13.text: Nitak hong bei-in zingsang hong tung a, ni thum ni ahi hi.

14.text: Pasian in, “Sun le zan a khen dingin vantungah khuavakte om hen; tuate pen pawi hun le khuahun, ni le kumte khen nading hi hen la,

15.text: leitung khua a vaksak dingin vantungah khuavak hi uh hen,” ci hi. Tua mah bangin a piang pah hi.

16.text: Pasian in khuavak lian nih bawl a, khuavak lianzaw pen sun a uk ding, khuavak neuzaw pen zan a uk dingin bawl a, amah in aksite zong a bawl hi.

17.text: Leitungah khua a vaksak ding, sun le zan a uk ding, khuamial panin khuavak a khenkhia dingin Pasian in vantungah tuate a koih hi. Pasian in tua pen hoih hi, ci-in a mu hi.

19.text: Nitak hong bei-in zingsang hong tung a, ni li ni ahi hi.

20.text: Pasian in, “Tuite in a nungta ganhing honpite piangsak hen la, vantung kantanin leitungah vasate leeng ta hen,” ci hi.

21.text: Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in tuipi ganhing golpite le amau nam ciatin tuipi sungah tampi a pha, nuntakna a nei a gamtang thei ganhing namkim le kha a nei vasa khempeuh amau nam ciatin a piangsak hi. Pasian in tua pen hoih hi, ci-in a mu hi.

22.text: Pasian in amaute thupha pia a, “Ci pha-in tampi pha-in, tuipi sung dim unla, leitungah vasate tampi pha un,” ci hi.

23.text: Nitak hong bei-in zingsang hong tung a, a ni nga ni ahi hi.

24.text: Pasian in, “Nuntakna a nei ganhingte amau nam ciatin leitung in piangsak hen: Innsa, gamsa, le a bokvak ganhingte amau nam ciatin piang ta hen,” a ci hi. Tua mah bangin a piang pah hi.

25.text: Innsa, gamsa, le a bokvak ganhing khempeuh amau nam ciatin Pasian in a piangsak hi. Pasian in tua pen hoih hi, ci-in a mu hi.

26.text: Tua ciangin Pasian in, “Eima lim, eimah hong sunin mihing bawl ni. Tuipi ngasate tung, huihlak vasate tung, ganhingte tung, le leitung a a bokvakte khempeuh tungah ukna neisak ni,” a ci hi.

27.text: Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in ama lim bangin mihing piangsakin, Pasian’ lim bangin amah a piangsak hi. Amah in pasal le numei a piangsak hi.

28.text: Pasian in amaute thupha pia a, Pasian in amaute tungah, “Ci pha-in tampi pha unla, leitung dimin zo un. Tuipi ngasate tung, leitungah a gamtang, a nungtate khempeuh tungah ukna nei ta un,” a ci hi.

29.text: Pasian in, “En un, leitung maitang khempeuhah a om, tang a piangsak kungnote khempeuh le a gah sungah tang a om singkung khempeuh note tungah kong pia khinta hi. Tuate an-in na nei ding uh hi.

30.text: Leitung ganhing khempeuhte tung, huih lak vasate khempeuh tung, leitungah a bokvakte khempeuh tung, nuntakna hu a neite khempeuh tungah an dingin kung hing khempeuh ka hong pia khinta hi,” a ci hi. Tua mah bangin a piang pah hi.

31.text: Pasian in a bawlsate khempeuh en a, hoih sa mahmah hi. Nitak hong bei-in zingsang hong tung a, a ni guk ni ahi hi.

1.text: Tua ahih ciangin vantung, leitung, le a sunga omte khempeuh kiman khin hi.

2.text: Ni sagih ma-in Pasian in a nasepte zo khinta a, ama hihsa nasep khempeuh panin ni sagih ni-in a tawlnga hi.

3.text: Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in ni sagih ni thupha pia-in siangthosak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh piansak nasepna ama nasep khempeuh panin tua ni-in Pasian a tawlnga hi.

4.text: Hihte pen, a kipiansak lai-a vantung le leitung tangthu ahi hi. Topa Pasian in leitung le vantungte a bawl hi.
4.title: Eden Huanah Mi

5.text: Topa Pasian in leitungah guah zusak nai lo a, leitang a kho ding mi om lo ahih manin gam sung kungnote lei sungah om nai lo a, lo sung ankungte pokhia lo hi.

6.text: Tua ciangin leitung panin meiilum kaaito-in, lei maitang khempeuh a buah hunin

7.text: Topa Pasian in leilak pana leivui tawh mihing bawl a, a nak sungah nuntakna hu sang suk hi. Tua mi pen leitung nuntakna a nei mihing hong suak pah hi.

8.text: Topa Pasian in nisuahna lamah Eden huan khat bawl hi. Tua lai munah ama bawlsa mipa koih hi.
8.title: Eden Huan

9.text: A deihhuai, nek dinga a hoih singkung nam khempeuh, huan laizangah nuntakna singkung, le a pha le a sia theihna singkung, lei sung panin Topa Pasian in posak hi.

10.text: Huan sung a kawtsak dingin Eden nawkin gun khat hong luang a, tua mun panin gun hong kikhenin li hong pha hi.

11.text: A masa pen gun a min Pishon hi a, kham a omna, Havilah gambup kimkotah a luang pen ahi hi.

12.text: Tua gam a khamte hoih hi. Tua munah bedolak singnai le onik suang om hi.

13.text: A nihna gun min Gihon hi a, Kush gam kimkotah a luang pen ahi hi.

14.text: Assiria gam nisuahna lamah a luang a thumna gun min Hiddekel ahi hi. A lina gun pen Eufratis gun ahi hi.

15.text: Topa Pasian in mipa la-in, Eden huan kho-in a kem dingin a koih hi.

16.text: Topa Pasian in mipa thu pia a, “Na ut utin huan sung singkung gah khempeuh na ne thei ding hi.

17.text: Ahih hangin a pha le a sia theihna singkung gah pen na ne kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua na nek ni-in na si ding hi,” a ci hi.

18.text: Tua ciangin Topa Pasian in, “Mipa amah guak a om ding hoih lo hi. Ama a’ ding a kituak a huh ding ka bawlsak ding hi,” ci hi.

19.text: Tua ahih ciangin Topa Pasian in gam sung ganhing khempeuh le huih lak vasa khempeuh lei tawh bawl a, mipa in tuate bang a ci hiam ci-in a theihna dingin mipa kiangah tuate a paipih hi. Nuntakna a nei khempeuhte pen mipa’ cih bangbang a min hi pahpah hi.

20.text: Mipa in ganhing namte khempeuh, huihlak vasate khempeuh le gam sung ganhing khempeuh min a vawh hi. Ahih hangin mipa a’ dinga a kilawm, amah a huh ding khat zong om lo hi.

21.text: Tua ahih ciangin Topa Pasian in mipa ihmut suak mahmah sak a, ama ihmut kalin a nakguhte khat la-in tua mun pen satak tawh a dimsak hi.

22.text: Topa Pasian in mipa’ tung panin a lakkhiat nakguh pen numei khatin bawl a, mipa kiangah tua nu a paipih hi.

23.text: Tua ciangin mipa in, “Tu petpetin hih pen keima guhte le keima sate ahi hi. Amah pen mipa sung panin a kilakhia ahih manin ‘Numei’ kici ding hi,” a ci hi.

24.text: Tua thu hangin pasal in a nu le a pa nusia-in a zi tawh kigawm a, amau tegel pum khat a bang uh hi.

25.text: Mipa le a zi a guaktangin om uh a, maizum lo uh hi.

info.name: Johan
info.desc: Johan Gen Lungdamna Thu in Jesuh pen mihing hong suakin, eite lakah a hong teng,

1.text: Tua khit ciangin Galilee gam sungah Jesuh zin kawikawi hi. Jerusalem khua-a om Jew mi uliante in amah thatnuam uh ahih manin Judea gam sungah zin nuam nawn lo hi.
1.title: Jesuh’ Sanggamte’ Uplohna

2.text: Jew mite’ Buk Pawi hun hong naita ahih manin,

3.text: ama sanggamte in Jesuh kiangah, “Na nung hong zui mihonte in na nasepna a muhtheih nadingun hih lai panin paikhia-in Judea gamah va pai in.

4.text: Mite’ theih ding a ut pa in a simthamin na sem ngei lo hi. Hih bangin na semsem na hih manin na sepna thu mi khempeuh theisak vet in,” ci-in zahpihna tawh thu gen uh a,

5.text: ama sanggamte mahmah in zong Jesuh um lo uh hi.

6.text: Ahi zongin Jesuh in, “Kei a dingin pai ding a hunhoih hi nai lo hi; ahi zongin note a dingin a hunhoih hi tawntung hi.

7.text: Leitung mite’ gamtatnate hoih lo hi, ci-in gen tawntung ka hih manin amaute in kei hong mudah uh hi; ahi zongin note hong mudah lo uh hi.

8.text: Tua ahih manin pawisiim dingin note va pai un. Kei a dingin a hunhoih hi nai lo ahih manin kei ka hong pai kei ding hi,” ci-in dawng a,

9.text: amah pai loin Galilee gam sung mahah a omlai hi.

10.text: Ahi zongin a sanggamte a dinkhiat khit ciangin Jesuh zong Jerusalem-ah Buk Pawi siim dingin a nungpai hi. Ahi zongin a kilang lua-in pai loin a simpai ahi hi.
10.title: Jesuh in Buk Pawi Nungsiim

11.text: Jerusalem-a om Jew mi uliante in tua pawi lak khawng Jesuh zong uh a, “Koi-ah om ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

12.text: Ama thu hangin mihonte lakah kam kihona tampi om a, “Amah mi hoih mahmah khat hi,” ci uh a, pawlkhat in, “Mi khemin a lam khialhpih ding pa ahih manin mihoih hi het lo hi,” a ci uh hi.

13.text: Ahi zongin Jerusalem khua-a Jew mi uliante a kihtakna hangun kuamah in Jesuh thu a kilangin gen ngam lo uh hi.

14.text: Pawi kham hunsung alang bang a bei khit ciangin biakinn sungah Jesuh lutin thuhilh ding a kipan hi.

15.text: Jew mi uliante in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, “Hih mipa cikmah a sang kah ngei lo kimlai bang hangin thu hih zah thei ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

16.text: Tua ahih manin Jesuh in, “Ka thugente pen keima thu hi lo a, kei a hong sawl Pasian kiang panin a hong pai thu ahi hi.

17.text: Pasian’ deihna bangin a gamta nuam mi peuhmah in, ka thugente pen Pasian’ kiang panin a hong pai thu a gen ka hihna leh keima thu bek tawh a gen ka hihna khenthei ding uh hi.

18.text: Amau’ thu bek tawh thu a gente in amau’ minthan nading a zong hi a, ahi zongin a hong sawl pa’ minthan nading a zong keimah in thuman thutak gen ka hih manin zuauthu kihel lo hi.

19.text: Moses in note tungah Thukham hong pia napi-in kuamah in na zui kei uh hi. Tua hinapi, bang hangin thah dingin kei hong sawm na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.

20.text: Tua ciangin mihonte in, “Dawivei hi teh! Kua in nang thah hong sawm ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

21.text: Jesuh in, “Sabbath ni-in cina damsakna nalamdang khat ka bawlna hangin lamdang na sa mahmah uh hi.

22.text: Moses in na tapate uh vun na at ding uh thu hong pia a, (a taktakin Moses thupiak mapekin na pu na pate un a palsat thu ahi hi) vun at ni ding le Sabbath ni a kituahkhak ciangin a vun na at veve uh hi.

23.text: Moses thupiakna a kipelh loh nadingin Sabbath ni-in vun at na hih uhleh Sabbath ni-in mi khat ka damsak manin bang hangin kei tungah heh na hi uh hiam?

24.text: A tungthama kimu nate siksanin thu khen kei unla, thu taktak siksanin thu khenzaw un,” a ci hi.

25.text: Jerusalem khuami pawlkhat in, “Thah dingin a sawm pa uh hih pa hi lo ahi hiam?
25.title: Hih pa Khrih Hi Ding Hiam?

26.text: Tua hinapi, mihon lakah thu gengen napi-in kuamah in bangmah cih lo uh hi. Uliante in Khrih hi, ci-in theihtelna nei uh hi ding hiam?

27.text: Tua ding lah, hih mipa hong piankhiatna i theih hi a, Khrih hong pai ciangin ama piankhiatna kuamah in a theih ding hi lo hi,” a ci uh hi.

28.text: Tua ahih manin biakinn sungah a gen mah bangin mi khempeuh zakin genkhia a, “Kei hong theitel taktak a, ka hong piankhiatna mun a thei takpi mah na hi uh hiam? Keima thu tawh a hong paitawm ka hi kei hi; kei a hong sawl a thuman pa a thei lo na hi uh hi.

29.text: Ahi zongin amah in kei hong sawlin, ama kiang panin a hong pai ka hih manin ke’n ka thei hi,” a ci hi.

30.text: Tua ciangin amaute in Jesuh mat ding hanciam uh hi; ahi zongin ama hun tung nai lo ahih manin kuamah in va su lo hi.

31.text: Ahi zongin mihon lak panin mi tampi mah in amah um uh a, “Khrih hong pai ciangin hih mipa sangin nalamdang tamzaw hong bawl tuan ding ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

32.text: Hih bangin mihonpite a kihona thu Farisi mite in za uh ahih manin amaute le siampi liante in Jesuh a man dingin biakinncing palikte pawlkhat a sawl uh hi.
32.title: Jesuh A Man Dingin Palikte Kisawl

33.text: Jesuh in tua mite kiangah, “Note lakah tawlkhat ka om lai ding a, tua ciangin kei hong sawl pa kiangah ka pai ding hi.

34.text: Keima omna munah note hong pai thei lo ding na hih manun tua hun ciangin kei nong zon uh hangin nong mu kei ding uh hi,” a na ci hi.

35.text: Tua ciangin Jew mi uliante khatlekhat kiho uh a, “I muh zawh loh dingin hih mipa koi lai-ah paisawm hi ding ahi hiam? Jew mite omna Grik khuapi tuamtuamte-ah pai-in Grik mite kiangah thu hilhsawm hi ding ahi hiam?

36.text: ‘Kei nong zon uh hangin nong muzo kei ding uh hi,’ a cihna leh ‘Keima omna munah nong pai thei kei ding uh hi,’ a cih ciangin bang a cihnopna hi ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a kikum uh hi.

37.text: Pawi bei ni ding pen a thupi pen ni hi a, tua ni-in mihon lakah Jesuh dingin nakpitakin kiko a, “A dangtak na om uhleh ka kiangah hong pai unla tui hong dawn un.
37.title: Nuntakna Tui

38.text: Lai Siangtho sungah, ‘Kei hong um mite sung panin nuntakna tui luangkhia ding hi,’ a cih mah bangin kei hong um mite ka kiangah hong pai-in hong dawn ta un,” a ci hi.

39.text: Jesuh in hih bang a gen ciangin amah a umte in a ngah ding Kha Siangtho thu a genna hi a, tua hun laitakin Pasian’ pianzia nei-in sihna panin Jesuh kithokiksak nai lo ahih manin Kha Siangtho kipiakhia nai lo hi.

40.text: Hih thu a zak uh ciangin mihon pawlkhat in, “Hih pa pen Kamsangpa taktak hi,” ci uh a,
40.title: Mihon Lungsim Kituak lo

41.text: pawlkhat in, “Hih pa, Khrih ahi hi,” a ci uh hi. Ahi zongin pawlkhat in, “Galilee gam panin Khrih hong piang ding ahi hiam?

42.text: Khrih i cih pen David’ suan hi ding a, David’ suahna Bethlehem khua-ah suak ding hi, ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah kigelh hi lo ahi hiam?” a ci uh hi.

43.text: Tua ahih manin Jesuh thu tawh kisai-ah mihonte’ lungsim kituak lo hi.

44.text: Mi pawlkhat in Jesuh man nuam uh hi; ahi zongin kuamah in su ngam lo hi.

45.text: Tua ciangin siampi liante le Farisi mite kiangah palikte a va ciahkik uh ciangin, “Bang hangin amah hong kai lo na hi uh hiam” a na ci uh hi.
45.title: Jew Mi Uliante’ Uplohna

46.text: Palikte in, “Hih mipa’ thugen bangin a gen kuamah om nai lo hi,” a cih uh ciangin

47.text: Farisi mite in, “Note zong hong khem khinzo ta ahi hiam?

48.text: Jew mi uliante hitaleh Farisi mite hitaleh sung panin amah a um, na theih uh omnai ahi hiam?

49.text: Hih mihonte in ahihleh Moses Thukham thei lo uh ahih manin Pasian’ samsiatna a thuak dingte hi lel uh hi,” a ci uh hi.

50.text: Tua hun ma-in Jesuh kiangah a va hawhsim ngei Nikodemas zong uliante sungah kihel ahih manin

51.text: amah in, “Mi khat peuhmah a thu dongin ama gamtatnate i theih masak mateng mawhsakna thu i khen ding pen i Thukham tawh kituak lo hi,” a ci hi.

52.text: Tua ciangin amaute in, “Nang zong Galilee gammi na hi hiam? Lai Siangtho sung sim lecin Galilee gam sung panin kamsang khat beek a pian’ ngei lohna thu na thei ding hi,” a ci uh hi.

info.name: Filemon
info.desc: Filemon pen Khristian ulian khat hi a, Kolose khuapi mi khat hi ding hi. Amah in

1.text: Khrih Jesuh hangin thong a kia keimah Paul le i sanggampa Timoti in, Ka hong it uh, ka naseppih uh ahi Filemon,
1.title: Hopihna

2.text: le na inn-ah a hong kikhawm pawlpite le i sanggamnu Apfia le thu upna-ah galkap khawmpih Arkhippas-te tungah lai ka hong khak uh hi.

3.text: I Pa Pasian le Topa Jesuh Khrih in note tungah dikna le nopsakna thupha hong tungsak tahen.

4.text: Pasian’ mite khempeuh na itna thu le Topa Jesuh na upna thu na zakhin ka hih manin Pasian kiangah thu ka nget simin nangmah hong phawkin Pasian tungah lungdamna thu ka ko tawntung hi.
4.title: Filemon in Itna le Upna A Neihna

6.text: Thu umte ihihna hangin Khristian sungah eite i kikholh manin, Khrih hangin i nuntakna sungah i ngah thupha a hoih khempeuh na theihna a kicin semsem nadingin thu ka ngen hi.

7.text: Sanggam aw, nangma hangin Pasian’ mite in lungnopna ngah uh ahih manin tua bang itna na neihna hangin ka lungdamin ka tha a nuam mahmah hi.

8.text: Tua ahih manin Khrih hangin unau khat ihihna tawh hih dingin a kilawm bangin na gamtat nadingin thu ka hong gen ngam hi.
8.title: Paul in Onesimas a’ ding Thumsak

9.text: Hih bangin ka hong genna pen itna i neihna hang ahi hi. Tu lai takin Khrih taangmi ahi keimah Paul zong, Khrih Jesuh hangin thongkia-in a om ka hi hi.

10.text: Tua ahih manin Khrih hangin ka ta ahi Onesimas a dingin ka hong thumsak hi. Thong sungah ka om sungun kha thu tawh kisai-ah ama pa ka suak hi.

11.text: Nidangin nang a dingin amah a kimanna bangmah om lo a, ahi zongin tu-in ei tegel a dingin mi manpha mahmah ahi hi.

12.text: Keima pumpi zahin ngaihsutna tawh nang kiangah amah ka hong puakkik hi.

13.text: Lungdamna Thu hangin thongkia-in ka om sungin nangma tangin kei a hong huh dingin ka kiangah ka omsak nuam hi.

14.text: Ahi zongin nangma nasep hoihna pen keima hong kalh hi loin nangma uttawmna tawh na sep a suahtheih nadingin nangma lungkimna om masa lopi-in bangmah ka hih nuam kei hi.

15.text: A tawntungin nang kiangah amah hong om paisuak theih nadingin tawlkhat sung nang kiang panin Onesimas a paikhia zong hi khathei ding hi.

16.text: Tu-in amah sal bek hi nawn loin sal sangin a thupizaw, Khrih hangin i sanggam hong hita hi. Kei a dingin amah a manphat mah bangin sal hihna le Topa thu sungah sanggam hihna tawh nang a dingin zong hong manphazaw kan ding hi.

17.text: Tua ahih manin nasepna-ah pawlkhat taktakin kei na hong ngaihsut nakleh kei na hong limbawl ding zahin amah na limbawl in.

18.text: Nang tungah hong khialh a, leiba thangba hong neih leh zong keima khialh, keima batin na seh in.

19.text: Keimah Paul in ka hong loh ding hi, cihna thu keima khut mahmah tawh a lai ka gelh ahi hi. Nangma nuntakna bulpi mahmah zong keima hang ahihna thu gen kullo hi.

20.text: Tua ahih manin sanggam aw, Topa’ hangin hih ka hong thumna hong pia in. Khrih sungah unau khat ihih manin ka lungsim hong nuamsak in.

21.text: Ka hong genna sangin a hoihzaw a phazaw-in na gamta ding, ci-in muan mahmahna tawh hih lai a hong gelh ka hi hi.

22.text: Tua banah, Pasian in note khempeuh’ thungetna hong pia-in, note kiangah kei hong paikik thei dingin kilamen ka hih manin ka om nading inndei zong a baihsa-in na bawl un.

23.text: Khrih Jesuh hangin thong ka kiatpih Epafras a kipan,
23.title: Vaikhakna

24.text: ka naseppih Marka, Aristarkhas, Demas, le Luka-te in hong hopih uh hi.

25.text: Topa Jesuh Khrih hehpihna thupha, note tungah hong tung tahen.
